commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: write inventory-api app"
sudo -n mkdir -p /opt/inventory-api
sudo -n tee /opt/inventory-api/app.py > /dev/null <<'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer

INVENTORY = {"widgets": 42, "gadgets": 17}

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            body = json.dumps({"status": "ok", "ts": time.time()}).encode()
        else:
            body = json.dumps(INVENTORY).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    server = HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()
PYEOF
sudo -n chmod +x /opt/inventory-api/app.py

echo "STEP: write systemd unit with strong OOM protection"
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service > /dev/null <<'UNITEOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory API
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-api/app.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=1
OOMScoreAdjust=-1000
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=false
User=root

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF

echo "STEP: enable and start service"
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable inventory-api.service
sudo -n systemctl restart inventory-api.service
sleep 1
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-api.service
echo "STEP: verify oom_score_adj applied"
PID=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value inventory-api.service)
echo "PID=$PID"
cat /proc/$PID/oom_score_adj
echo "STEP: curl health check"
curl -sf "http://$NODE_IP:8080/health"
echo
echo "STEP: write memory-hog script (unmanaged, default oom_score_adj=0)"
sudo -n tee /opt/memory-hog.py > /dev/null <<'HOGEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import time
chunks = []
try:
    while True:
        chunks.append(bytearray(10 * 1024 * 1024))
        time.sleep(0.05)
except MemoryError:
    while True:
        time.sleep(1)
HOGEOF
sudo -n chmod +x /opt/memory-hog.py
echo "DONE setup"
